node.name: CSFR TOKEN
node.rich_text:
Unique secret generated by server and shared with client:
Req. looks like this;
Has many implementation vulnerabilities: (open children notes for more)
1. Request Forgery -> using different Parameter 2. Simply removing token cause they only check when its actually present 3. CSRF where token is not tied to user session -> u can use any valid token(yours f.e.) 4. CSFR token is tiedd to a non-session cookiee -> Extra header which ties csfr token to a cookie but not necassarily the session cookie 5. CSRF Token and Cookie are the same and server jsut checks if identical.: Attack similar to 4 but you can “invent” a CSFRKey
